clips.title: The story
paras: Ruul Eagletalon asks you to test your readiness against the Windfury harpies in Mulgore. The hunt takes you to the southeastern cliffs, where their speed and claws put your skill to the test before you leave the tauren homeland.

In Bloodhoof Village, Ruul Eagletalon watches travelers pass through Mulgore. He asks those coming of age or preparing for wider travels to prove their combat instincts. Beyond Mulgore's sheltered valleys, survival demands poise against cunning foes, and Ruul measures your mettle against the land's fiercest native predators.

The Windfury harpies roost along Mulgore's southeastern mountain rim, away from the beaten trails. They threaten wandering wildlife and isolated travelers, diving swiftly and striking with razor-sharp claws as they hunt for fresh flesh. Defeating them and bringing back their talons proves you can overcome a settled threat and react quickly to aerial attackers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thank you for taking the time to speak to me, friend. I am Ruul, warrior and teacher.
You have obviously reached an age when you must prepare for your trials if you are to adventure much further out of Mulgore.
If you wish a test of your strength, start by seeking out the Windfury harpies to the southeast. They nestle along the mountain's edges away from the road.
They are one of our natural enemies here in Mulgore and will be a good gauge of your skill.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Windfuries are deadly foes. Their strength in battle is only rivaled by their desire for fresh meat.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well, friend. You seem well prepared to travel onward. Let the wind always be at your back.
